cues.text: At Naganaki Shrine, Koromaru runs ahead of you up the path, turning back again and again to look at you.
Further into the shrine grounds, Koromaru trots ahead of you to a stone guardian-dog statue and stops, facing you, then lowers his nose to the ground.
You crouch down in front of Koromaru. A small collar lies on the stones at his feet.
You pick up the collar. Koromaru turns away toward the shrine and lifts his head.
